invariants: Generic — no word from the private word list anywhere in the repository
Fixed flow — the eight statuses and who sets them change only with a decision record
Both shells — every script exists in PowerShell and bash and behaves the same
Config-driven — a project-specific value lives in .claude/nightmill.json, never in a skill or script
Compatible — slot markers and config keys stay readable by the previous version

verification.manualCheckText: Run the changed skill in a real project with `claude --plugin-dir <this checkout>` and watch it take the right steps
verification.benchRule: A script that runs in the smoke tests keeps its scenario there; a new script flag gets a smoke step in both shells

storyTriggers: a change to the status flow or who sets a status
a new, renamed or removed config key
a change to the slot marker format

parallel.doNotPair: two tasks that both change the slot scripts or both change the schema

runHints: claude --plugin-dir . (in a project checkout, pointing at this slot) to try the change
